mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) directly reduces the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows, increasing present value and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days. This effect is consistent across monetary policy cycles.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 4.5% (2023-09-15 level), or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 305.0) signals imminent central bank tightening, increasing discount rates and compressing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 305.0, or the Rank IC is negative over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad-based demand contraction, reducing corporate revenue expectations and driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline by >0.5% month-over-month, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), labor market tightness fuels wage inflation, prompting aggressive monetary tightening that depresses equity valuations and causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0%, or the Rank IC for the regime-specific signal is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates stronger economic activity, boosting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO rises, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Declining housing starts (HOUST < 1400.0) signal weak consumer demand, reducing corporate revenue expectations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST < 1400.0, or the Rank IC is negative over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in FEDFUNDS > 5.0% and CPIAUCSL > 305.0 indicate aggressive monetary tightening amid high inflation, compressing equity valuations and driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 5.0% and CPIAUCSL > 305.0, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP level (GDPC1) below 20500 billion dollars indicates economic slowdown, reducing corporate earnings growth expectations and driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 < 20500.0, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.02 over any 3-year window.
